issue: Can skip all Recall/Quiz without an attempt
reproduction_evidence: Flow from P00-01 to A5-02 with 0 learning attempts; all 4 pairs bypassed via Next
repair: Add a non-punitive completion checkpoint: when skipping, show clear choice do now / postpone; distinguish SKIPPED, ATTEMPTED, VERIFIED, never MASTERED automatically. Gate section transition on meaningful attempt or explicit skip acknowledgment; provide return path.
acceptance: Given incomplete Recall and quiz, Next prompts; skip is explicitly logged; no false completion.

issue: Can bypass diagnostic and remediation without checking
reproduction_evidence: If no Check is clicked, routeIndex skips D0-R01/R02
repair: Prompt to check both diagnostic answers before advancing, or explicitly mark "chưa làm" and offer mini-remediation; no forced wrong answer.
acceptance: Untested foundations are flagged, learner offered remediation, correctly answered routes remain efficient.

issue: Exploration lacks prediction before model output
reproduction_evidence: runLab on A2-04 has no prediction validation; diagram already shows Cookie arrow
repair: Add one compact choice "có gửi/không gửi" before Run and dynamically change arrow on result; keep concise 70/30 layout.
acceptance: Both conditions are predicted before revealing outcome; result diagram agrees with model.

issue: Recall self-attestation may not reflect actual retrieval
reproduction_evidence: Click "Em đã nói và ghi từ khóa" opens model without independent evidence
repair: Keep accessible oral/paper attempts. Label status SELF_REPORTED, allow short optional note or tutor verification, never mark MASTERED from click; show retry suggestion after comparison.
acceptance: Click creates SELF_REPORTED only, cannot be auto-graded, tutor can verify later.

issue: Feedback reveals full correction even after wrong attempt
reproduction_evidence: check(...) sets revealed:true even when good=false; second attempts can read right solution
repair: For incorrect attempts show targeted first hint, reveal complete rationale on explicit request or retry; do not block indefinitely.
acceptance: Wrong first attempt yields hint but not all correct labels; after retry explicit reveal possible.

issue: Final retrieval can be revealed without attempt
reproduction_evidence: Mindmap reveal and flashcard flip operate immediately, only textual prompt says try first
repair: Reuse self-report before reveal, or offer clear skip with logged status.
acceptance: Mindmap and cards follow same attempt-before-reveal rule as section recall.

issue: QA traceability inconsistency in local frozen contract
reproduction_evidence: Local contract/09-10-approved-contract.json contains status NOT_RUN and proposed text; user approval exists in GitHub new branch but not local copy
repair: Regenerate local approved contract and QA summary from same source; include approval ID in archive and hashes.
acceptance: All deliverables consistently reference user-approved 3270s and Skill11 build, no stale proposed flags.

reproduction_evidence: Wrong answer says Try again with no context-dependent hint
repair: Add 1 hint per misconception/question, optional second hint after repeat, then explanation.
acceptance: Each wrong path gives actionable non-answer hint.

issue: Teacher verification of speech/paper output has no structured teacher UI
reproduction_evidence: Teach-back and paper responses are not directly verifiable in learner-only site
repair: Provide teacher review checklist in separate guide or import/export verification form; preserve student privacy.
acceptance: Teacher can mark verified without posing as auto-score.

issue: No real student, Windows file-open or English mode validation
reproduction_evidence: Playwright simulated data, file:// restricted in runner, EN_PENDING
repair: Field test with learner and Windows, accessibility/screenreader if possible, complete EN only if included in release scope.
acceptance: Evidence recorded per real test; failures not hidden behind structural pass.
